observations: Black ergonomic office chair with a curved mesh back and a separate, curved footrest.
Silver five-star base with black casters.
Adjustable armrests with black plastic caps.
The chair is positioned in a living room setting with a grey sofa and a dark wood TV stand.
The mesh back and the footrest cushion show significant dark staining and discoloration.

claims.evidence: The chair appears structurally intact and correctly assembled in photo 0.

claims.claim: Bought new last year, no stain, no tear, foam still firm. From a smoke free home.
claims.evidence: The presence of stains on the mesh and the footrest in photo 0 contradicts this claim.

risks.risk: The mesh back and the footrest cushion may be stained or worn beyond repair.
risks.proof: A photo of the mesh and cushion cleaned and showing their condition.
risks.if_unproven: as heavily stained and requiring replacement of the mesh/cushion

risks.risk: The chair may have mechanical issues with the gas lift or armrests.
risks.proof: A video showing the chair being raised and lowered and the armrests being adjusted.
risks.if_unproven: as having broken or non-functional mechanisms

risks.risk: The base or casters may be damaged or missing.
risks.proof: A photo of the base and casters from a different angle.

proof_requests: Photo of the mesh back and the footrest cushion showing their actual condition.
Video of the chair being adjusted to demonstrate all functions.
Photo of the underside of the chair to check for damage.
response.reason: The item is known from the photos. What they cannot prove is priced at its worst case until the proof asked for below arrives.
